findings.where: Results › Risk factors for adverse clinical courses
findings.quote: Barbiturate/non-barbiturate overdose was independently associated with increased odds for a prolonged ICU stay (OR: 2.97; 95% CI: 1.60, 5.55) and aspiration pneumonitis (OR: 3.83; 95% CI: 2.18, 6.79) relative to overdose with only other sedative-hypnotics (i.e., benzodiazepine overdose).
findings.text: Barbiturate overdose increases the odds of a prolonged ICU stay (OR = 2.97) and of aspiration pneumonitis (OR = 3.83) compared with benzodiazepine overdose.

findings.quote: Second, we observed that barbiturate overdose increased the odds of aspiration pneumonitis compared to other sedative-hypnotic overdose (i.e., benzodiazepine overdose).
